Recipe.Name: HuH Load 60V 12A - Meatest 9010+D, Keithley 3706A
Recipe.Description: Calibration of Höcherl & Hackl Electronic Load ZS 530-3-SV60-ZS02-ZS13-SA9 using Meatest 9010+D as calibrator and Keithley 3706A as reference meter. Based on TÜV Rheinland procedure "HuH Load 60V 12A 5502A, 8846A".
Recipe.Author: CalibrationApp
